d: Abhinetri rashmika mandana aur unke pati vijay devarkonda in dinon soshal midiya par charcha men hain. donon ne soshal midiya par alag-alag post ke zarie apne rishte par uth rahe savalon aur troling ka javab diya hai. mamla hal men prasarit hue tivi sho 'kophi vid karan 9' ke ek episod se shuru huaa, jismen rashmika mandana aur vijay devarkonda sath pahunche the. sho men donon ne apne rishte aur shadi ke bare men bat ki thi. is batchit ke bad soshal midiya par vijay devarkonda ke ravaiye aur donon ke rishte ko lekar kaee tarah ki tippaniyan hone lagin. janie ye pura mamla kya hai aur…
